name: Newport
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Newport?
answer_short: Street-legal low-speed vehicles yes, plain golf carts no. In Newport, a registered low-speed vehicle may use a public road posted 35 mph or less. Rhode Island does not register a golf cart as that vehicle.

golf_cart.notes: A golf cart is not registered as a low-speed vehicle

lsv.roads: Public roads posted 35 mph or less
lsv.notes: Registered, insured, and inspected. A city ban must be posted.

rules.rule: A registered low-speed vehicle may use a public highway posted 35 mph or less, and may cross a highway posted 35 to 45 mph at a signal or stop sign.
A golf cart is not manufactured to the low-speed vehicle standard and may not be registered for public roads.

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Newport?
faq.a: Public roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered, insured, and inspected. A city ban must be posted. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a regular golf cart in Newport?
faq.a: No. Rhode Island does not register a golf cart as a low-speed vehicle.
